Title: Generally available: Bring your own Container Network Interface plugin

Body.Content:
AKS now supports deploying clusters with no pre-configured Container Network Interface (CNI) plugin. This facilitates use of almost any CNI plugin, whether open source or commercial, which allows you to maintain the same CNI across clusters both in and out of Azure or utilize features from other plugins to enable specific configurations you may require.

Learn more.
